decisions.reason: The added keyway groove concerns the sliding mandrel and does not change the welding, premachining, or post-weld machining sequence for POS 1, POS 2, and POS 3.
A missing groove on the sliding mandrel does not change the bushing's shaft fit, guidance role, retention method, or existing holes.

The source explicitly requires a keyway groove on the sliding mandrel, whereas the existing omitted-keyway rule applies to cross section C-C of the main shaft; the two part-specific rules can remain simultaneously valid.
Adding a keyway groove to the sliding mandrel does not alter any specified part material or the requirement to show materials on drawings.
The sliding-mandrel keyway groove does not affect the specified 45-degree angle between lug hole axes.
The correction may require updating the model artifact, but it does not change the candidate's current requirement state that a 3D shaft assembly model be delivered.
The sliding-mandrel geometry correction does not change the rule for numbering individual drawings according to the assembly.
The correction belongs to the sliding-mandrel feature requirement and does not change the requirement to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set.
